verify.note: Measures the consequence in both directions: no merged commit names an id the row set lacks, AND a wired guard keeps it that way, because patching two holes by hand leaves the hole. Reads the last 400 subjects of the current branch. Failed on 2026-09-28 on the first arm (HYG-125, LIVE-475) before this row was worked; the rows and the wired guard closed it. Exits 79 if git is unavailable. Mutation-test by deleting either added row. HYG-145 (ADR-1635): reads the merged view (base file plus docs/ledger fragments) through scripts/lib/ledger.mjs, so a child closed by a fragment counts. 2026-11-09 (owner phrase "rewrite the HYG-124 probe to read multi-part row ids"): the id pattern now takes the whole of a multi-part id (LIVE-FEED-DAYTIME, not LIVE-FEED), the same shape check:shipped-ids reads, so a row named that way is found rather than reported missing.

append.detail: 2026-11-09: the probe cut a multi-part row id at its second hyphen (LIVE-SUBDOMAIN-ATTRIBUTION read as LIVE-SUBDOMAIN, no row), which a depth-1 pull-request checkout never showed because its one merge subject names no id; the first push-to-main run for such a title would have failed. Daniel: "rewrite the HYG-124 probe to read multi-part row ids". The pattern now matches the whole id, as check:shipped-ids already did.
